description: This PHP source file generates a popup form for rescheduling a call in the SugarCRM system. It retrieves call details, formats date and time inputs based on user preferences, and outputs an HTML form with dynamically populated date and time selection options.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: A class representing a call entity, used to retrieve call data.

methods.name: getPreference
methods.description: Gets user preferences such as time format, date format, and display name preference.

methods.name: getLocaleFormattedName
methods.description: Formats the user's first and last name according to locale settings.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches call details based on call ID.
